endo_report_raw: Esophagus mucosa smooth, soft, dentate line clear. Cardia and Fundus: unremarkable. Body: mucosa reddish, linear hyperemia(+), no ulcer/bleeding. Angulus: localized elevation with edema/erosion, central depression, covered with old blood crust. Antrum: mixed red and white mucosa. Pylorus & Duodenum: round, open/close well, mucosa smooth, bulb and descending part (-).
endo_report:
This is a gastroscopy report.
Esophagus: Mucosa is smooth and soft, with clear vascular pattern, good distensibility, and a distinct dentate line.
Cardia: No significant abnormalities observed.
Fundus: No significant abnormalities observed.
Body: Mucosa is smooth and reddish; no ulcer or bleeding noted, with scattered linear areas of hyperemia.
Angulus: Mucosa shows mixed red and white appearance; a localized elevated area with edema and erosion is seen, with slight central depression covered by old blood crust.
Antrum: Mucosa shows mixed red and white appearance.
Pylorus: Round in shape, opens and closes adequately; mucosal folds are smooth and pale pink, with no ulcer or bleeding.
Duodenum: No abnormalities observed in the bulb or descending portion.

endo_report_raw: Scope advanced to terminal ileum, mucosa unremarkable. IC valve lip-shaped, appendiceal orifice seen. Hepatic flexure: flat polyp ~0.6cm, snare polypectomy. Descending colon: scar-like change at 42cm from AV. Sigmoid colon: 30cm from AV, 0.4cm flat polyp, snare polypectomy. Transverse colon and Rectum: (-).
endo_report:
This is a colonoscopy report.
Ileum: The colonoscope was advanced smoothly to the terminal ileum; mucosa appears normal.
Ileocecal region: Lip-shaped ileocecal valve and crescentic appendiceal orifice observed.
Ascending colon: No significant abnormalities observed.
Hepatic flexure: A flat polyp approximately 0.6 cm in size with smooth surface was identified and removed using a snare.
Transverse colon: No significant abnormalities observed.
Splenic flexure: No significant abnormalities observed.
Descending colon: Scar-like change noted at approximately 42 cm from the anal verge.
Sigmoid colon: A flat polyp approximately 0.4 cm in size with smooth surface was identified at approximately 30 cm from the anal verge and removed using a snare.
Rectum: No significant abnormalities observed.
